component.title: Popover
component.purpose: Keep secondary actions anchored to their trigger without losing focus, layer, or responsive discipline.

states.description: An anchored menu is visible in its settled layout.
A consumer can open, navigate, and dismiss the menu.

claims.statement: The surface measures its trigger, flips at viewport edges, clamps within safe margins, and keeps its arrow aligned to the trigger.
The trigger exposes dialog relationships, the top layer owns Escape, outside interactions dismiss, keyboard focus is bounded, and focus returns to the trigger.
The anchored surface becomes a mobile sheet with safe-area spacing and inherits shared Presence reduced-motion behavior.
